MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AND PROPRIETARY INFORMATION AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT (hereinafter referred to as the "Agreement") is made and entered into as of 14 October 2026 (the "Effective Date"), by and between:

(1) VECTRA LOGIX SYSTEME AG, a stock corporation (Aktiengesellschaft) established and existing under the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, registered with the Commercial Register (Handelsregister) of the Local Court (Amtsgericht) of Frankfurt am Main under HRB 94821, having its principal place of business at Theodor-Heuss-Allee 108, 60486 Frankfurt am Main, Germany (hereinafter referred to as "Vectra Logix"); and

(2) HALYARD SOFTWARE LTD, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of England and Wales, registered under company number 09876543, having its registered office at 12 Mill Lane, Manchester M1 2AB, United Kingdom (hereinafter referred to as "Halyard").

Vectra Logix and Halyard may hereinafter individually be referred to as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties".

PREAMBLE

WHEREAS, Vectra Logix is a leading provider of enterprise resource logistics, automated distribution infrastructure, and related cloud architecture; and

WHEREAS, Halyard provides specialized B2B software solutions and enterprise workflow tools; and

WHEREAS, the Parties intend to enter into discussions and evaluations concerning a potential mutual business transaction, strategic software integration, and commercial cooperation (the "Permitted Purpose"); and

WHEREAS, during the course of such discussions and evaluations, the Parties recognize that each may find it beneficial to exchange certain proprietary, commercial, operational, and technical information; and

WHEREAS, the Parties desire to define the terms and conditions under which such exchanged proprietary information shall be managed, held in confidence, protected, and utilized;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants, promises, and undertakings herein contained, the Parties hereby agree as follows:

DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 In this Agreement, the following terms shall have the respective meanings set forth below:

1.1.1 "Affiliate" means any legal entity that, directly or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a Party. For the purposes of this definition, "control" means the direct or indirect ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting capital or voting rights of such legal entity, or the factual or legal power to direct or cause the direction of the management and operational policies of such entity, whether through contractual rights, ownership, or otherwise.

1.1.2 "Agreement" means this Mutual Non-Disclosure and Proprietary Information Agreement, including any annexes, schedules, and written amendments executed pursuant hereto.

1.1.3 "Business Day" means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or statutory public holiday on which banking institutions in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, and London, United Kingdom, are open for ordinary commercial transactions.

1.1.4 "Confidential Information" means all information, data, materials, and know-how, whether of a commercial, financial, technical, structural, strategic, or legal nature, disclosed directly or indirectly by or on behalf of Vectra Logix to Halyard, whether disclosed orally, visually, electronically, in writing, or in machine-readable form, including but not limited to trade secrets, system architecture, source code, object code, application programming interfaces (APIs), database designs, technical specifications, algorithms, flowcharts, pricing models, customer rosters, vendor contracts, business plans, and market analyses, which is either designated in writing as "Confidential", "Proprietary", or with a similar restrictive legend at the time of disclosure, or which by its very nature or the circumstances surrounding its transmission ought reasonably to be understood by a prudent commercial person as being confidential and proprietary.

1.1.5 "Disclosing Party" means the Party disclosing Confidential Information hereunder.

1.1.6 "Effective Date" has the meaning ascribed to it in the opening paragraph of this Agreement.

1.1.7 "Intellectual Property Rights" means all statutory and non-statutory intellectual and industrial property rights worldwide, including patents, utility models (Gebrauchsmuster), design rights, trademarks, service marks, trade names, trade dress, copyrights, database rights, rights in software, domain names, moral rights, rights in trade secrets and know-how, and all applications, registrations, extensions, and renewals pertaining to any of the foregoing.

1.1.8 "Permitted Purpose" has the meaning ascribed to it in the Preamble.

1.1.9 "Receiving Party" means the Party receiving Confidential Information hereunder.

1.1.10 "Representatives" means the directors, statutory executive officers (Vorstandsmitglieder), managing directors (Geschäftsführer), employees, authorized professional legal advisers, tax consultants (Steuerberater), statutory auditors (Wirtschaftsprüfer), and technical consultants of a Party or of its Affiliates who require access to the Confidential Information strictly for the execution of the Permitted Purpose.

1.2 In this Agreement, unless the context explicitly requires otherwise:

1.2.1 references to Clauses and Schedules are to the clauses and schedules of this Agreement;

1.2.2 words importing the singular shall include the plural and vice versa;

1.2.3 headings, clause titles, and paragraph numbering are inserted for convenience of reference only and shall not influence the legal interpretation or substantive construction of this Agreement;

1.2.4 references to statutory provisions or legal enactments shall be construed as references to those provisions or enactments as amended, substituted, modified, or re-enacted from time to time; and

1.2.5 the terms "include", "includes", "including", and "in particular" shall be construed without limitation.

CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-USE UNDERTAKINGS

2.1 In consideration of the disclosure of Confidential Information, the Receiving Party covenants, warrants, and undertakes to the Disclosing Party that it shall:

2.1.1 hold and maintain the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information in the utmost confidence and not publish, disclose, disseminate, or make available such Confidential Information, in whole or in part, to any third party, legal entity, or unauthorized person without the express prior written consent of the Disclosing Party;

2.1.2 use and reproduce the Confidential Information solely, strictly, and exclusively to the extent indispensable for the performance and realization of the Permitted Purpose, and refrain from utilizing, exploiting, or commercializing the Confidential Information for its own economic benefit, for competitive purposes, or for the benefit of any third party;

2.1.3 apply to the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information the highest standard of technical and organizational security measures, and in any case no less than the degree of care and diligence that a prudent enterprise in the software industry exercises over its own confidential assets of comparable sensitivity, but under no circumstances less than a reasonable standard of commercial care;

2.1.4 refrain from copying, transcribing, replicating, or preparing summaries or extracts of the Confidential Information, except to the minimal extent strictly necessary for the fulfilment of the Permitted Purpose, whereby all such authorized duplicates, extracts, or records shall immediately constitute and remain the property of the Disclosing Party; and

2.1.5 not decompile, reverse engineer, disassemble, decrypt, decode, analyze the internal structure of, or otherwise attempt to derive the human-readable source code, core algorithms, internal architecture, or foundational ideas of any software, data files, prototypes, or technical artifacts made available by the Disclosing Party.

2.2 The Receiving Party shall notify the Disclosing Party immediately in writing upon becoming aware of any actual, suspected, or threatened breach of security, loss, unauthorized disclosure, or improper utilization of any Confidential Information, and shall, at its own expense, take all reasonable and necessary steps to cooperate with the Disclosing Party to mitigate the effects of such unauthorized disclosure and regain exclusive possession of the affected materials.

EXCLUSIONS FROM CONFIDENTIALITY

3.1 The obligations and restrictions set forth in Clause 2 shall not apply to any specific portion of information as to which the Receiving Party can prove by objective, contemporaneous written records:

3.1.1 is already generally known, public, or publicly accessible at the time of its disclosure by the Disclosing Party, or subsequently enters the public domain through no fault, act, or omission on the part of the Receiving Party or its Representatives;

3.1.2 was already lawfully and demonstrably in the possession of the Receiving Party prior to disclosure hereunder, without any preexisting duty of confidentiality or non-disclosure;

3.1.3 has been or is lawfully received by the Receiving Party from an independent third party who has the lawful right to make such disclosure and is not bound by any non-disclosure obligation toward the Disclosing Party; or

3.1.4 has been independently developed and authored by employees or agents of the Receiving Party who have had no access to, familiarity with, or reference to the Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party.

PERMITTED DISCLOSURES AND REPRESENTATIVES

4.1 The Receiving Party may transmit or disclose the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information only to those of its Representatives who have a strict need to know such information for the implementation of the Permitted Purpose, provided always that:

4.1.1 the Receiving Party has informed each such Representative of the proprietary and confidential nature of the Confidential Information prior to any transmission;

4.1.2 each such Representative is bound by statutory professional secrecy duties or by written confidentiality undertakings no less stringent and comprehensive than the terms contained in this Agreement; and

4.1.3 the Receiving Party remains unconditionally and fully liable for any breach of this Agreement, unauthorized use, or unlawful disclosure committed by any of its Representatives, as if such act or omission were the direct act or omission of the Receiving Party itself.

MANDATORY DISCLOSURE ORDERS

5.1 If the Receiving Party or any of its Representatives is required by an enforceable order of a competent judicial court, administrative authority, government agency, or mandatory statutory law to disclose any Confidential Information, the Receiving Party shall:

5.1.1 provide the Disclosing Party with prompt written notice thereof as soon as legally permissible, enabling the Disclosing Party to seek a protective order, injunctive decree, or other appropriate legal remedy;

5.1.2 consult in good faith with the Disclosing Party regarding the scope and timing of such disclosure; and

5.1.3 if disclosure remains legally unavoidable, furnish only that minimal portion of the Confidential Information which is strictly mandated by the applicable order or statutory rule, and exercise all reasonable efforts to secure confidential treatment for the information so disclosed.

RETURN AND DESTRUCTION OF MATERIALS

6.1 Upon the written demand of the Disclosing Party, or automatically upon the termination or expiration of this Agreement, the Receiving Party shall, at the choice and discretion of the Disclosing Party:

6.1.1 within ten (10) Business Days, return to the Disclosing Party all documents, data carriers, samples, models, storage media, and tangible representations containing or embodying Confidential Information; or

6.1.2 within ten (10) Business Days, securely destroy, shred, or permanently erase all copies, reproductions, analyses, summaries, and electronic records containing or reflecting any Confidential Information, ensuring that such data cannot be reconstructed or retrieved using standard recovery mechanisms; and

6.1.3 provide within fifteen (15) Business Days of receipt of such request a formal written confirmation, executed by an authorized executive officer or director, certifying the comprehensive and unreserved compliance with the obligations set forth in this Clause 6.1.

6.2 Notwithstanding Clause 6.1, the Receiving Party and its legal advisers shall be permitted to retain:

6.2.1 one archival copy of the Confidential Information solely in secure, locked legal custody to the extent strictly required to substantiate compliance with applicable statutory record retention obligations (handels- und steuerrechtliche Aufbewahrungspflichten) or mandatory regulatory requirements; and

6.2.2 electronic data remnants created pursuant to automated, routine electronic backup procedures, provided that such backup data is not readily accessible to operational personnel and is securely overwritten or deleted in the normal operational cycle.

6.3 Any Confidential Information retained pursuant to Clause 6.2 shall remain strictly subject to all confidentiality, secrecy, and non-use restrictions contained in this Agreement for an indefinite period until complete erasure.

INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND WORK RESULTS

7.1 All Confidential Information, as well as any and all Intellectual Property Rights subsisting therein, shall remain the sole and exclusive property of the Disclosing Party or its respective licensors. Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as conferring, conveying, or transferring to the Receiving Party any ownership title, proprietary right, or commercial interest in or to the Confidential Information.

7.2 Except for the limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, and revocable right to evaluate the Confidential Information solely for the Permitted Purpose during the term of this Agreement, no licence or exploitation right is granted or implied under any patent, utility model, copyright, trademark, trade secret, or other Intellectual Property Right of the Disclosing Party.

7.3 In the event that Halyard, its Affiliates, or its Representatives generate, conceive, develop, or reduce to practice any improvements, modifications, derivative works, software routines, configurations, feedback, or complementary technical inventions that arise from, are suggested by, or relate to the Confidential Information, system designs, or technical documentation of Vectra Logix, all Intellectual Property Rights in and to such improvements, modifications, derivative works, and inventions shall automatically vest in, be assigned to, and become the exclusive global property of Vectra Logix from the moment of their creation, and Halyard hereby assigns to Vectra Logix all present and future worldwide right, title, and interest in and to any such developments, free of any encumbrance or royalty claim.

7.4 Halyard undertakes to execute all such formal declarations, transfer deeds, assignments, and patent application forms, and to perform all such supplementary legal acts, as Vectra Logix may reasonably require to register, perfect, enforce, and defend the Intellectual Property Rights assigned pursuant to Clause 7.3 before any national or international patent and trademark authorities.

NO WARRANTY AND AS-IS BASIS

8.1 All Confidential Information is made available by the Disclosing Party strictly on an "as is" and "with all faults" basis. The Disclosing Party makes no representation, guarantee, or warranty, whether express, statutory, or implied, regarding the accuracy, technical feasibility, completeness, commercial utility, freedom from third-party intellectual property defects, or merchantability of the Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement.

8.2 The Disclosing Party shall have no liability whatsoever for any direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, or economic loss or damage arising from or in connection with the Receiving Party's use of, reliance upon, or inability to use the Confidential Information, except in instances of deliberate intent (Vorsatz) or gross negligence (grobe Fahrlässigkeit).

8.3 Neither Party is under any legal obligation by virtue of entering into this Agreement to disclose any specific piece of information, to proceed with the Permitted Purpose, or to execute any subsequent commercial, development, supply, or licensing agreement.

TERM AND TERMINATION

9.1 This Agreement shall take effect as of the Effective Date and shall remain in full force and effect for a term of two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party upon serving thirty (30) calendar days' prior written notice of termination to the other Party.

9.2 The confidentiality, non-use, and non-disclosure obligations set forth in Clause 2, Clause 4, Clause 5, and Clause 6 shall survive the termination or expiration of this Agreement for a period of five (5) years following the effective date of such termination or expiration; provided, however, that with respect to any information constituting a trade secret under applicable statutory law, such confidentiality and non-use covenants shall survive for an unlimited period of time for as long as such information maintains its legal status as a trade secret.

9.3 The provisions of Clause 7, Clause 8, Clause 10, and Clause 11 shall survive any expiration or termination of this Agreement indefinitely.

REMEDIES AND INJUNCTIVE RELIEF

10.1 The Parties acknowledge and agree that any violation, unauthorized disclosure, or breach of the provisions of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm, commercial disadvantage, and substantial injury to the Disclosing Party for which financial damages alone would not constitute an adequate or complete remedy.

10.2 In the event of an actual or imminent breach of this Agreement, the Disclosing Party shall be entitled, in addition to all other statutory claims for monetary damages or restitution, to seek preliminary and permanent injunctive relief (einstweiliger Rechtsschutz), specific performance, and any other provisional remedies before any court of competent jurisdiction, without the necessity of proving actual damages or posting a security bond.

GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION

11.1 This Agreement, including its validity, interpretation, performance, and all claims, controversies, or disputes arising out of or in connection with this Agreement or its subject matter (including non-contractual claims, tort claims, and pre-contractual negotiations), shall be governed exclusively by, and construed in accordance with, the substantive laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, without giving effect to any principles of conflict of laws (Internationales Privatrecht) that would lead to the application of the laws of any other jurisdiction. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG) shall not apply.

11.2 To the extent legally permissible under section 38 of the German Code of Civil Procedure (Zivilprozessordnung - ZPO), the Parties agree that the exclusive place of jurisdiction (ausschließlicher Gerichtsstand) for all disputes, controversies, or claims arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, its formation, or its breach shall be Frankfurt am Main, Germany.

GENERAL MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS

12.1 Neither Party shall be entitled to assign, transfer, sub-license, delegate, or otherwise encumber any of its rights, claims, or obligations under this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the other Party; provided, however, that Vectra Logix shall be entitled to assign this Agreement without consent to an Affiliate or in connection with a merger, reorganization, or sale of substantially all of its assets.

12.2 Amendments, modifications, or supplements to this Agreement, including this Clause 12.2 itself, must be made in writing and signed by duly authorized representatives of both Parties in order to be legally effective (Schriftformerfordernis). No oral side agreements have been entered into.

12.3 If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, void, or unenforceable in whole or in part by any competent judicial court or regulatory authority, such invalidity shall not affect the validity or enforceability of the remaining provisions hereof. The Parties shall replace the invalid, void, or unenforceable provision with a valid and enforceable provision that comes as close as commercially and legally possible to the intended economic and legal purpose of the invalid provision.

12.4 The failure or delay by either Party in asserting or exercising any right, power, or remedy under this Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of such right, power, or remedy, nor shall any single or partial exercise thereof preclude any other or further exercise thereof. Any waiver must be in writing and signed by an authorized representative of the waiving Party.

12.5 This Agreement constitutes the complete, final, and exclusive understanding and agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior written or oral discussions, promises, letters of intent, heads of terms, drafts, and representations relating thereto.

12.6 This Agreement may be executed in two or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Transmission of signed execution copies by electronic transmission in portable document format (.pdf) or via an authorized electronic signature system shall be legally valid and binding upon the Parties.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have caused this Agreement to be executed by their respective duly authorized officers as of the date first above written.
